steps.note: the API built this case's state
Configure the event as an RFQ, matching the test setup.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Create one comparable line item for the two vendor bids.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite two vendors so the report contains two vendor columns.
Submit the first vendor bid at 100.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor bid at 90 to produce a lower-ranked comparison.
Confirm the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Close bidding so Master QCS and reporting are available for the completed RFQ.
Open the comparison grid that the report must match.
Assert that both real vendor columns are present in Master QCS.
Read the first vendor's unit price from the comparison grid.
Read the second vendor's unit price from the comparison grid.
Assert that ranks follow the quoted amounts, with the 90 bid ranking ahead of the 100 bid.
Assert each vendor's line amount equals rate times quantity and each total equals the sum of line amounts.
Download the Master QCS comparison report from the same screen being checked.
Verify the downloaded report contains the deterministic event title and both quoted prices.
